title: The Signature Portfolio Project Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Project briefs, sample deliverables, and skill categories. The Portfolio Project Database provides project briefs designed to build demonstrable skills: the brief, suggested deliverables, the skills each project demonstrates, and difficulty ratings. Briefs span fields from software to design to writing so every major has portfolio material. The Signature side adds review checklists that judge a finished project the way a hiring manager would.
capabilities: Provide project briefs with deliverables and skill tags
Rate difficulty and estimate build time per brief
Cover briefs across majors and fields
Supply hiring-manager-style review checklists
Link briefs to the skills they demonstrate
